messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nAdmins cannot export full audit logs from the Keelwater platform. This prevents compliance teams from conducting required reviews, leading to missed internal deadlines, delayed audits, and an increased risk of non-compliance.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Account administrators** who are responsible for generating compliance reports and cannot export the necessary audit data [i:948c66e71bd187ff].\n- **Internal compliance teams** at customer organizations who rely on exported logs to meet their review deadlines [i:948c66e71bd187ff].\n\n## Evidence\nThe problem is reported by 1 account [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. It has been mentioned 1 time [i:948c66e71bd187ff], specifically through the account management route [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. The affected account, Brantwick Commercial, has stated that we can pull full audit logs for admin review — it’s becoming urgent for our compliance team... we really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. This account has an ARR of £150,000.0 [i:948c66e71bd187ff].\n\n## Why now\nThe customer, Brantwick Commercial, indicated the need is becoming urgent as of 2026-09-01 [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. With 0 renewals in the last 90 days, retaining this high-value account may depend on addressing this compliance-critical feature gap before their renewal date on 2027-05-11 [i:948c66e71bd187ff].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "948c66e71bd187ff",
   "quote": "we can pull full audit logs for admin review — it’s becoming urgent for our compliance team... we really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines",
   "account": "Brantwick Commercial",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-01T12:50:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-10-01",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "account_management": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 150000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Brantwick Commercial",
    "arr_gbp": 150000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-05-11",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I verified all cited claims against the insight and fact sheet: 1 account (Brantwick Commercial), 1 mention via account_management route, ARR of £150,000, 0 renewals in the last 90 days, renewal date 2027-05-11, and urgency date of 2026-09-01 (matching the insight's timestamp) all match. The customer quote is reproduced verbatim and correctly attributed, with quotation marks only around the actual quote text. Scope claims (account administrators and internal compliance teams affected) are reasonable paraphrases of the cited insight, and no contrary evidence exists. Nothing is overstated.", "verdict": "pass"}
